name: Naimeh Salem
tagline: Top rated Immigration attorney in Houston, Texas
about: Attorney Naimeh Salem is a highly recognized Attorney with over 10 years of experience in Immigration Law. Attorney Salem strives to educate all clients on the immigration process and offer solutions that meets the individual needs of each family. Attorney Salem is fluent in both English and Spanish and holds the exceptional ability to communicate effectively.

Attorney Salem graduated Magna Cum Laude from the Inter American University of Puerto Rico, Faculty of Law. While earning her Juris Doctor, she graduated as one of the top 10 students in her class and was admitted to the Puerto Rico Bar in 2007.
She was admitted to practice law in Texas in 2012. Since being admitted to practice law, Ms. Salem has represented businesses and families in a long list of immigration related matters.

Attorney Salem is admitted to the United States Supreme Court, the First, Second, Third, Fifth, Sixth, Ninth, and Tenth Circuit Court of Appeals, the Southern Federal District of Texas, and is a member of the American Immigration Lawyers Association.

As she protects the rights of her clients when it comes to immigration issues, Ms. Salem strives to find the best, most efficient solution for each individual case. Rather than taking a one-size-fits-all approach, she creates a personalized approach to each individual case.
